items.q: After 400 hours, which Claude Code skills do clients pay for?
items.a: Not flashy demos — **six boring types** that **save time, cut costs, or remove mistakes**, repeatable across real estate, HVAC, coaching, and marketing. Sell **outcomes** (hours saved, fewer errors, more leads), not "an AI workflow."

items.q: What's the difference between a skill and a plugin?
items.a: A **skill** is a markdown SOP package; a **plugin** can bundle multiple skills + hooks + MCP servers. Don't install all six day one — learn one, demo value, then compound.

items.q: Why is Skill Creator the factory behind paid work?
items.a: Describe a job in plain English (or drop in an SOP); Claude drafts, tests, and packages **`SKILL.md`**. Clients don't buy Skill Creator — every paid skill comes from it. Install globally at user scope.

items.q: What failure mode does Superpowers fix?
items.a: Rushed code that looks fine until a client runs it. It forces **plan → isolated env → tests before code → two-stage review**. Realistic first-pass: ~**80%** with QA framing vs ~**60%** without. (**150K+** GitHub stars.)

items.q: How do GSD and Context Mode attack mid-session walls?
items.a: **GSD** spins fresh sub-agents per task so the main session stays clean (scope-drop + security gates). **Context Mode** sandboxes tool output — e.g. **56KB → 299 bytes** Playwright snapshots — so sessions that died at ~**30 min** run ~**3 hours**.

items.q: When should you use `/review` vs `/ultra review`?
items.a: `/review` for **fast local feedback**; **ultra** for payments/auth/DB migrations — cloud sandbox with parallel reviewers that must **independently reproduce bugs**. Needs Claude account sign-in; Pro/Max gets ~**3 free** ultra runs, then ~**$5–20**/run.

items.q: What does Claude Mem add that Context Mode doesn't?
items.a: **Cross-session** memory: lifecycle hooks → semantic summaries in local SQLite + vector search, **~10× token savings** vs dumping history, and auto-updates folder-level **`CLAUDE.md`**. Use marketplace install — `npm install` SDK-only won't register hooks.
**Frontend Design** (official) — install globally for **less AI-slop UI**. Complements Claude Design; still useful when projects return to Claude Code.
